findings.placement: All three candidates sit 12px below the narration card and remain above the playable character and traversal path.
findings.occlusion: Visible prompt footprint is reduced by 56-67% from the captured current prompt.
findings.hierarchy: The narration card remains primary; the compact prompt reads as a subordinate one-line action cue.
findings.localization: The center slice supports 300px ko, 380px en and 520px qps-long profiles without moving the top-center anchor.
findings.input: Keyboard and gamepad use the same blank runtime glyph slot; no E/A/B glyph is baked.
findings.states: Far hides the prompt, near shows one compact prompt, and popup-open hides it while preserving the existing facility popup.
findings.bakedText: No localized body or button text was added to any new candidate fragment. The legacy text appears only inside the supplied current-state evidence quadrant.
